title: Staff can change any member's tap card link from the CyberUnicorn console

source.ref: Daniel, 2026-11-06: easy way to change a member's card link, search site pages or any external URL.

detail: Card links box on /admin/cyberunicorn: find a member, see where their card opens, pick a site page or paste any https link, save. Staff only (consoleStaffGate); same normalizer as the member's own editor.
